cli.byte_comparison: 20 copied detector .mjs/.js files byte-identical to bundled detector. Comparison included 21 files; sole mismatch was absent optional detect.mjs launcher. Invoked byte-identical detector/detect-antipatterns.mjs directly using parser dependencies already installed in isolated /tmp tool copy.

overused-font.evidence: Roboto follows the explicit Home Assistant identity in PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md and the ui.py body font stack. Replacing it for novelty would conflict with the brief.

flat-type-hierarchy.evidence: The detector compares maximum/minimum font size across all headings, body, labels and captions, and warns below 2.0. HA uses 12px captions, 14px body, 16px labels and 20px card headings. Inspected screenshots had recognizable heading/card/task hierarchy. No task-level hierarchy failure was verified from these warnings.

dark-glow.evidence: ui.py .choice:has(input:checked) uses inset 0 0 0 1px var(--primary-color); focused inputs use 0 0 0 1px var(--focus-color). These are zero-blur selection/focus outlines. Browser screenshots show sharp outlines, not decorative glow. Recurrence on pages without choice cards comes from shared stylesheet inspection.

cramped-padding.evidence: residents.html zero-padding div.card and section.card contain details.expand; summaries and contents own the insets. Browser measured card-header 16px 16px 8px and card-content 0px 16px 16px. Screenshots show inset QR content and disclosure labels; padding the wrapper would duplicate the insets.

fixture_scope_notes: 35 responses; 31 nonempty application pages carry warnings, three 303 bodies are empty, and one standard 404 is not application markup.
Supplied /grant query returned 400 recovery. Valid resident states used current contract /splash/grant; no app validation was modified.
portal-group-finished was actually a 400 Check your details response after stale CSRF reuse, not successful logout.
portal-expired-callback was captured after legacy mode; standard 404, not verified Duo expiry state.
Synthetic services only; no live credentials, real CA private key or WPN signing key used.
